description: This file declares functions for applying patches to a RTL826XB PHY device, including individual and broadcast patch functions, as well as initialization of patch database. It includes conditional include directives based on compilation environment.

methods.name: phy_rtl826xb_patch
methods.description: Apply patch data to a specific PHY unit and port.

methods.name: phy_rtl826xb_broadcast_patch
methods.description: Apply patch data to multiple PHY units or ports in broadcast mode.

methods.name: phy_rtl826xb_patch_db_init
methods.description: Initialize the patch database for a given PHY port.
